changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review attempt is fenced on its own lease, not on the worker that claimed it. A running attempt of the previous release gets a lease that no worker holds, so it expires and the attempt is recovered.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_job SET lease_id = gen_random_uuid() WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
CREATE INDEX ix_review_job_running_lease ON review_job (leased_until) WHERE status = 'RUNNING'

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup before starting the previous release.
